{{Infobox place|name=The Sleeping Sea|type=Sea|region=West and south of [[the Banner-lands]]|notable=Few ships return from the deep water|sources=[[The Songs]]; charts of [[House Tidebreaker]]}}
'''The Sleeping Sea''' bounds [[the Banner-lands]] to the west and south. Near the coast it is navigable and generous; farther out it is fog-bound and untrustworthy. Few ships that make for deep water return, and those that do carry contradictory stories. It is the only direction in which the map ends in uncertainty rather than stone.

[[House Tidebreaker]] faces it from [[the Shards]], and keeps [[the Wave-Reader]]'s lighthouse shining not toward the harbor but out over the empty sea — as if calling home what never comes back. What lies beyond the horizon is one of the realm's oldest open questions.
